name: Nanase Ren
source:
Nanase Ren is two grades above Makoto, and a senior in the Basketball club who is thoughtful of his juniors. He enjoys amusing others, so he can come off a little eccentric at times. He always acts like what you'd expect the model senior to behave; amicable, caring, and willing to lend a hand. He always seems to show up at the strangest times.

Special Skill: Cooking
Type Preference: Someone cheerful
Personality: Affectionate, yet also free-spirited.
Habit: Running his hand through his hair

"I wish magic could be used to make everyone happy, just like Witches from fairy tales..."

[From English patch notes]
